summary: Background ISO upload in Recent tasks with cancel and rate; remove fixed 8 GiB ISO size cap in favour of free-space staging.

guide.reason: ISO library upload can be dismissed while the Controller transfer continues; operators use Recent tasks for progress, rate and Cancel; prerequisites no longer claim an 8 GiB cap.

api.reason: Changed contract: POST /api/v1/media no longer rejects solely for body over 8 GiB; admission uses staging free space minus a 256 MiB reserve. Auth, one-at-a-time transfer, CD001 and host iso-import are unchanged.

state.reason: Client upload UX and Controller staging admission bounds only; durable ISO records remain pool-scoped iso-import resources on the pool master as before.

verification.method: go test ./internal/controller/ ./internal/protocol/ ./internal/vmhost/ -count=1; web npm run typecheck; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree. Browser walkthrough of dismiss/cancel/rate left open for disposable lab.
